text:
mariana: Quick heads-up — we just GA'd the Mobile Streaming SDK v1.0 and the new mosaic-mini model for low-latency mobile use. Docs + migration guide are live. :party:
aj: Huge — congrats team! Any breaking changes from the beta SDK?
mariana: API surface mostly the same, but switching to websocket multiplexing by default. Old single-conn SDK will be deprecated (see schedule below).
ryan: Love to see the perf numbers — can we surface p50/p99 for a typical 128-token chat?
mariana: p50 ~45ms, p99 ~180ms on mosaic-mini 8-bit on our mobile GPU profile. We'll post a benchmark summary in docs.
devx-bot: Migration snippet:
```
const sdk = new RedwoodMobile({ socketUrl: 'wss://hosted.redwood.ai/mobile-stream/v1' });
const session = await sdk.openSession({ model: 'mosaic-mini-v1' });
session.stream("Hello")
  .on('data', chunk => console.log(chunk))
  .on('end', ()=> console.log('done'));
```
aj: Nice, will update the RN plugin this week. Any token counting changes?
mariana: No token model change — same billing semantics. Only connection multiplexing and smaller default buffers.
ops-bot: Rollout plan (GA): 10% customers -> 50% in 24h -> 100% in 48h. Old mobile SDK deprecation: warnings start in 2w, forced migration in 8w.
alex: SRE note — watch for websocket connection storms during rollout. We have circuit breakers and backpressure, but keep pager on standby during the 50% jump.
emily: I'll update the reseller/partner note and notify top customers about the mosaic-mini option for mobile.
mariana: Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/mobile-streaming (migration guide + changelog). If you want a demo walkthrough DM me or @aj. :shipit:
